notes.title: Demo Update - Co-op!
notes.content:
[h2]Demo Update[/h2]

[b]It’s been five months since the last demo update, and a lot has happened in Space Scavenger’s development![/b]

This update improves a lot of things and brings it closer to where the full game is headed. Expect new weapons to experiment with, new level types, more Gadgets, new pre-made difficulty tiers and, of course, the biggest addition: Local split-screen co-op! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43289120/efa6132b1eaa6862a4e5be5c6d62281d8329eb6b.png[/img]
[h2]Co-op[/h2]
Co-op is here! Team up with a friend and take on the demo together! Work as a duo to scavenge, build, and survive the first sector of the game. Share resources, combine your strengths, and back each other up when things get tough. Whether you divide your firepower evenly or support each other with specialized roles, teamwork will be the key to survival!

Steam Remote play works great for playing with a friend remotely!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43289120/67d95a8a81228fe585b0884315d68bc7d52a23c3.png[/img]

I hope you enjoy the demo! Please consider leaving a review on the Demo page, it helps spread the word about the game to more people!

Thanks!
[i]/Jonas
Red Cabin Games[/i]

notes.title: Development Update - Winter 2025
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone, Jonas here! Time for a Space Scavenger 2 development update![/h3]

[h2]What's been done?[/h2]
I've been working on Space Scavenger 2 for 3 years now and it's really coming together!
I could go into detail about the development of all the systems - let me know if that's something you'd be interested in! But to keep it short, most core systems are done or very close to done, along with 4 sectors and 3 bosses. Which means the game is playable from start to finish, including an early version of the final boss. 

It feels good to play and you can get some pretty fun builds going! There's also meta progression, where more of the game gets unlocked as you play more, including higher difficulty levels.

Split-screen co-op has been planned since the start and recently received some love and attention to make it more solid. The Demo will be updated soon with some new stuff, including co-op!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43289120/e3ff1bde2c084349030e2e85be57342b22396117.png[/img]
[h2]What's left to do?[/h2]
My goal for the coming months is to tie everything together in a way where I [i]could[/i] release the game into Early Access if I really wanted to. That means:
[list]
[*] Refining the Upgrade system
[*] Adding more Modules and Gadgets
[*] Expanding the meta progression with ship skins and starting capsules.
[*] Implementing Saving and Loading
[*] Adding a mode with online leaderboards.
[/list]
Right now, the game always follows the same 3-4 sector path, later in the year I want to add at least 2 more sectors so that you can choose a new path in each run, playing new sectors, with different enemies, planets and gameplay mechanics. 

[h2]Final thoughts[/h2]
I hope you found this update interesting! If you want to get involved you can join the Space Scavenger Discord to play early test builds and give feedback.

If you don't want to go that far, you can always leave comments and questions here on Steam and try the Demo!

If there's anything you're curious about, let me know and I'll try to answer, or if it's a big topic I might do another update post about it!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43289120/46afe3116c9c4a87856756515f213494104ca968.png[/img]
/Jonas
Red Cabin Games

notes.title: Demo Patch 2
notes.content:
Hello again! 
Another patch for the Demo!

tl:dr
Improved tutorial instructions, fixed bugs, less noisy fire effects

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ship Details button can now be rebound properly.
[*] Fixed bug where throwing axe could get left behind on the previous level. 
[/list]
[h3]Tutorial[/h3]
[list]
[*] Clear arrow throughout the tutorial pointing the way.
[*] Dynamic text instructions based on player actions.
[*] Added extra dialog before voidborn arrival in tutorial.
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] Clearer visuals when Boss has shields active
[*] More transparent artillery targeting and friendly AOE markers.
[*] Fewer Outposts/NPCs in sector map. Better spread.
[*] Reduced glow on fire visuals to reduce visual noise
[*] Gauntlet settings are saved after exiting the game. 
[*] Small balancing changes
[*] Added new Loading Screen tips.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43289120/67d95a8a81228fe585b0884315d68bc7d52a23c3.png[/img]

Known issue:
Sometimes gamepads/controllers can stop functioning. I'm looking for the issue, but it might not be solved for a while. 

Enjoy!
/Jonas

notes.title: Demo Patch 1
notes.content:
Quick first patch for the Demo!

tl:dr
Fixing a couple of critical issues and made the demo one level longer, more difficult default settings.

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed soft lock issue in Tutorial if you recycled Spare Parts before talking to the NPC.
[*] Fixed bug when stunning boss while it's jumping (With upgraded Tesla Coil)
[*] Energy now recharges correctly when entering a new level.
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] More difficult default settings.
[*] Tutorial explains difficulty settings.
[*] Bosses are 80% immune to stuns.
[*] Added an extra level to make the demo a bit longer.
[*] Some more Boss HP to compensate for longer run.
[*] Adjusted some Drone Gadget numbers.
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Target FPS setting.
[*] Adjusted background saturation to improve visual clarity.
[*] Reduced saturation on Poison areas to reduce visual clutter.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43289120/67d95a8a81228fe585b0884315d68bc7d52a23c3.png[/img]

Keep the feedback coming, I'll do some more updates for the Demo!

Enjoy!
/Jonas
